asset_requirements.note: ClearScale is a DSP time-stretch library, not a neural model; no neural weight is applicable. The exact licensed source or binary implementation and any coefficient table it needs are required.

caller_asset_contract.notes: Every implementation artifact, config, licence, rights record, cohort manifest, parity vector, runtime lock and output-use grant must exist at an absolute path and match its declared SHA-256 before a caller may process audio. No upstream revision is pinned because the merged evidence records only an abandoned project with no usable current licence or status. This package does not import or execute the asset.

required_geometry.status: exact_input_boundary_only; candidate rate semantics, buffering, content delay and final-padding geometry unestablished

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply one exact ClearScale source checkout at an immutable 40-hex revision under research/tsm-followup-20261101/clearscale or data/checkouts/clearscale; no such checkout exists in the workspace and the merged note records an abandoned project.

Provide a current, reviewed licence and project-status record for the exact artifact: copyright ownership, source and binary terms, redistribution, derivative-output use, patent status and commercial-use permission. The note records no usable current licence or status, so no rights can be assumed.

Supply the exact licensed source or binary implementation with byte counts and SHA-256 values, plus any coefficient table it requires. ClearScale is a DSP library, not a neural model; no neural weight exists to substitute.

Record the exact sample rate, channels, frame/hop, rate-factor and pitch semantics, rate-change bounds, content delay, latency, final-padding rule and reset behavior in a pinned config; the merged note contains no ClearScale geometry or API.
Provide an isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock at data/envs/clearscale/requirements.lock and a recorded platform; no environment, package pin or lock exists.

Clear source, binary, training/coefficient, contributor, corpus, speaker-consent, source-audio, output-use and redistribution rights, then add the rights record and output-use grant; no rights record exists and the project status is abandoned.

Produce one approved exact-runtime 1x/rate-change output plus a rights-cleared held-out cohort and parity vector covering unfamiliar speech, music, silence, rebuffer, drift and the final partial window; no output, parity vector or cohort exists.

Measure pitch, transients, speech preservation, peaks, nonfinite failures, alignment, content delay, buffering, deadlines, memory and CPU, then complete opt-in intake and release review; no quality, listening, device-timing or release result exists.

gates.requirement: The full 40-hex source revision, exact source/binary implementation, coefficient tables and metadata SHA-256 values and the source licence match exact pins.
An isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock is admitted on a recorded platform, including the exact compiler, link mode and instruction-set assumptions.

The abandoned-project status, copyright ownership, source and binary licence, redistribution, derivative-output use, patent status and commercial-use rights are cleared with notices and an output-use grant.

The exact sample rate, channels, frame/hop, rate-factor and pitch semantics, rate-change behavior, content delay, latency, final-padding rule and reset behavior are pinned in one immutable configuration.
A rights-cleared held-out rate cohort scores 1x, rate changes, unfamiliar speech, music, silence, rebuffer, drift and the final partial window with stratified controls and failure cases.

Paired or unpaired evidence separates duration mapping, pitch, transient audibility and speech preservation from output peaks, nonfinite failures, alignment and authorized listening; target-device pacing, fill/flush, deadlines and resource use are measured separately.
Explicit opt-in provider intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision are complete; the component ships optional only.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Measure exact source-sample to output-sample mapping, content delay and the final partial window for the intended frame path.
Measure output duration identity, floor/ceil error and cumulative drift for 1x and every supported rate factor.
Measure pitch preservation and transient audibility for 1x, rate changes, music and speech.
Include 1x, rate changes, unfamiliar speech, music, silence, rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.
Keep pause, filler and rate decisions tied to exact source timestamps rather than a separate wall clock.
Measure speech, consonant and intelligibility preservation for every rate decision.
Measure fill/flush, rebuffer, underrun and recoverable buffering on the intended playback path.
Score a rights-cleared held-out cohort of unfamiliar speech, music and silence with matched controls and failures.
Measure memory, CPU, deadlines and actual availability on the intended device and runtime.
Run authorized listening separately where permitted references exist; listening is not inferred from synthetic arithmetic.
